description: `print repcount` outside any enclosing `repeat` raises `ol-repcount-outside-repeat` at the registry's usual stage `semantic` (`spec/error-model.md:120`, `spec/commands.md:793`) — issue #1155. Whether a `repcount` has an enclosing `repeat` is a lexical property of the source, so `check()` decides it and the check-before-execution gate (`spec/execution-model.md:632`) refuses the program: ZERO events, nothing half-executed. This description previously carried three separate faults, corrected together. (1) It asserted `stage: "runtime"` and one `instruction` event — the program printed part of itself before stopping. (2) It justified that with `execute() never runs check()`, which #815 made false, measurably: a top-level `stop` returns a `semantic` diagnostic and 0 events. (3) Both of its citations were wrong: `spec/error-model.md:118` is `ol-duplicate-binder`, not this code, and its `spec/commands.md` citation pointed at line 792, a BLANK line between the example fence and the `Possible errors` bullet — it resolved to nothing and supported nothing. That second half was found by re-checking every claim here, not only the ones the issue named. It had been deferred to the #948 sweep as undecidable between lines 791 and 793; reading it decides it, since the claim is about the error this code raises and 791 is a code fence, so the exception is deleted rather than re-fingerprinted.
